component.name: Blanc
component.summary: Minimal, privacy-focused browser with built-in ad and tracker blocking

description.p: This is a community package of Blanc, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.
Blanc is a desktop web browser built around a minimal floating "Island" toolbar that keeps out of the way of the page, with ad and tracker blocking built in.

ul.li: Built-in ad and tracker blocking, no extension needed
A command palette for tabs, history and actions
A start page with your shortcuts

description.p: Updates are delivered through Flatpak; Blanc's own updater is switched off in this package.

Downloads go to your Downloads folder by default; saving anywhere else goes through the file-chooser portal. Importing bookmarks and history from another browser needs read access to that browser's profile, which is not granted by default. To allow it for Chrome, for example:
The other supported sources are ~/.config/chromium, ~/.config/BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser, ~/.config/microsoft-edge and ~/.config/vivaldi.
